# ufw_status (Resource)

Manages the UFW firewall enabled/disabled status on a remote Linux system via SSH.

## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether UFW firewall should be enabled (true) or disabled (false).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for the UFW status resource.
